exposures_by_days.description: Weekly exposures by the days the athlete trains (the nearest listed count at or below theirs); 0 leaves the module out. Overrides exposures_per_week.

periods.description: The module's weeks in a repeating cycle of periods, counted in program weeks (BJJ: StrengthLog's six weeks of strength, a deload week, five of power). A period may name its own rotation of variants; a deload period deloads the module in place of the framework's cadence, and one with its own rotation runs those workouts as written. Fatigue or a deload phase still deloads it.

note.description: What the period asks of every block, leading its note (Persist's Bridge week: everything at RPE 6–7).

phases.description: The track's phases this module runs in (Uphill's General Strength in Transition, its muscular endurance in Specific); without it, every phase. Its periods count the phase's weeks.

exposures_by_phase.description: Weekly exposures in a named phase, over exposures_per_week (Uphill's Zone 3: one a week in Base, two in Specific).

drop_when_injured.description: A block whose every option the athlete's injuries rule out is left out, and the program says so, instead of the track refusing (BJJ's StrengthLog lifts, the owner's call); missing equipment still refuses.

rotation_holds.description: The rotation stays on its last variant once it gets there, instead of starting again (Uphill's ten muscular-endurance workouts, then the tenth).

may_share_day.description: An optional module that may join a day the essential modules use when its minutes fit beside them (Wildman's programs stack into one session); free days are still taken first.

never_with.description: Modules this optional one never shares a day with (BJJ's conditioning stays off class days).

when_mastered.description: Joins the week only once `requires_mastery` is confirmed (mastered_exercises or the level's seeds); until then it is left out and the program says so, rather than the track refusing.

optional.description: Supplementary work the method lets the athlete skip: placed only on days no essential module uses, left out with its reason when none is free or its movement is ruled out.

advice.description: What the method recommends and the app leaves to the athlete — said, never enforced (Wildman: repeat the workouts after more than a week away). It ends the note of every block that advances the module.

start_minutes.description: weekly_volume: the week's aerobic minutes in the program's first week, by training level.

ramp_pct.description: weekly_volume: the rise a build week adds over the one before.

build_weeks.description: weekly_volume: build weeks before each recovery week; the next block starts one step above the last.

recovery_pct.description: weekly_volume: a recovery week's (or any deload's) minutes, as a share of the last build week's.

ramp_phases.description: weekly_volume: the phases the minutes ramp in; in any other phase they hold at the last build week before it (recovery weeks still recover). Without it, every phase ramps.

share.description: weekly_volume: each session's share of the week's minutes (the long day 0.5), or `rest`: what the week's other volume modules leave, over this module's sessions.

pack_pct.description: weekly_volume: [from program week, % of bodyweight] — the pack the volume block names from that week (Uphill: none for four weeks, then 5, 10, 15).

round_kg.description: load_per_exposure: weights round to this plate step.

stall.description: load_per_exposure: misses in a row at one weight before it resets by reset_pct; a lift that stalls again after `resets` resets (default 1) has finished its progression and holds.

light_day.description: From `after_resets` resets of `lift`, the week's `exposure`-th session lifts it light: `pct` of the last weight made, `sets` × `reps`, not advancing it (Alter: day 2 at 80 % of day 1, 2×5).

scheme.description: From `after_resets` resets, each of `lifts` runs `sets` × `reps` in the same minutes (Alter: 5×3 for the squat, bench and press).

lifts.description: load_per_exposure: per lift (exercise id), the kg added after a made exposure — increments_kg[0] for the first `first_exposures`, then a step smaller, and a step smaller after each reset.

interval_sec.description: Per stage of `rounds`, the interval each round takes (default 60: an EMOM). Wildman's swing program runs 60-second minutes, then 90-second start/stop rounds.

cues.description: Per stage of `rounds`, what changes in the movement (start/stop: park the bell between reps).

variants.description: Sessions that alternate (Starting Strength's Workout A and B, the Texas Method's three days): the rotation names one per exposure, so the module runs A-B-A one week and B-A-B the next.

rotation.description: Variant ids in exposure order, repeating.

alternatives.description: Substitutes the method accepts, in order: the first the athlete's equipment and injuries allow is prescribed.

reps.description: Reps per set, or as the source writes them: a range ("6-8"), a distance ("20 m"), per side ("8/side").

load_note.description: How the athlete chooses the load (StrengthLog: add weight once every set makes its reps), in place of an RPE target.

deload_keep.description: The share a deload keeps of this block; 0 drops it.

optional.description: A supporting block left out, and said so, when none of its options fits the equipment or injuries; an essential block refuses instead.

volume.description: weekly_volume: the block whose minutes are the session's share of the week; its duration_sec is replaced.

progresses.description: Carries the module's progression without a bell (an easy run's minutes); a loaded block always does.

intensity.description: A prescribed intensity; a zone counts the block's heart rate in the analytics.

pct.description: load_per_exposure: a share of the lift's last made weight (the Texas Method's Monday 5×5 at about 90 %); such a block reads its lift and does not move it on.

advances.description: load_per_exposure: whether a made exposure of this block moves its lift on (default: a loaded block at full weight does).

to_failure.description: Sets to failure (Rippetoe's chin-ups): no fixed reps.
